description: This is a utility class named ThreadUtil providing static methods for thread sleep and execution, including running Runnables normally or as daemon threads.

classes.name: ThreadUtil
classes.description: A final utility class containing static methods for thread management, including sleeping and running Runnables.

methods.name: sleep
methods.description: Pauses the current thread for the specified number of milliseconds, handling InterruptedException with logging.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Starts a new thread to run the provided Runnable.

methods.name: runAsDaemon
methods.description: Starts a new thread as a daemon thread to run the provided Runnable.
